neighbours.label: the capitalized word ' Historical' or ' Historic' opening an institution or publication title (Trust for Historic Preservation, journal Historical Studies); lowercase 'historical' in prose and other capitalized title words stay quiet
fire: She published two papers in the journal Historical Research last year.
Funding came from the Society for Historical Archaeology in 2004.
He was elected president of the Historical Association of Ohio.
The house is listed on the National Register of Historic Places.
A grant from the Fund for Historic Theatres paid for the new roof.
The lecture was printed in Historical Essays, edited by two professors.
Volunteers at the Office of Historic Preservation sorted old maps.
